settings.intro: After each publication the new release is compared with the previous one for a while: share of 5xx answers, new PHP errors, a health check every minute. Verdict: healthy, degraded, failed, or not enough traffic (fewer than {{requests}} requests).
settings.modeLabel: When a release is degraded or failed
settings.revert: Put the previous release back if it failed
settings.modeHint: Alert: a notification for a degraded or failed release. Automatic return: a failed release is replaced once by the previous one — never a release that ran database migrations (alert only), never after a rollback.
settings.windowHint: A clearly failed release is judged after 2 minutes; otherwise at the end of the window.
settings.revertNeedsPublish: The automatic return takes the right to publish releases.
